description.value: A small vehicle-accessible campground at the northern tip of Hwy 101 near Lund, sitting on the doorstep of Desolation Sound Marine Park with 14 seasonal tent sites plus 4 year-round walk-in sites (off-season: free, no services, user-maintained). The shore is rocky with no sand — paddlers thrive here, casual swimmers less so.

address.value: Northern terminus of Hwy 101, 19 km north of Powell River, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active provincial park campground on the Malaspina Peninsula with 14 seasonal vehicle-accessible tent sites and 4 year-round condensed sites (18 total, matching OSM capacity). The website describes swimming, canoeing, kayaking, and fishing activities but provides no information about cyclist-specific amenities like hiker/biker sites, showers, or potable water. OSM tags confirm internet_access=no and sanitary_dump_station=no. Reservations are confirmed via the BC Parks reservation system referenced on the park page and the frontcountry camping subpage.
concerns: OSM community listed as 'Unknown / Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands' but the park is on the Malaspina Peninsula near Powell River (Sunshine Coast), not on Vancouver Island
Phone number in OSM (+1-250-286-9992) belongs to the park operator McGrath Contracting Ltd., not BC Parks; this number does not appear on the park's website page
No street address available; location described only as '19 km north of Powell River' at the northern terminus of Hwy 101
OSM says internet_access=no; no evidence of any electrical hookups or charging facilities
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground at the end of Highway 101 with year-round availability on some sites. A natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast to its northern terminus at Lund.
enrichment_extras.notes: Lund, the closest community, is approximately 9 km west by road and may offer food and supplies for touring cyclists.
